import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Net gain if we fly straight to the candidate now and collect its value, minus time cost of getting back to charger: (value - rate*travel) minus travel_time*drain*recharge_time_equivalent, normalised."""
    d = np.linalg.norm(targets - pos, axis=1)
    is_item = values > 0
    travel = d  # speed 1
    # value remaining when we arrive (item decays during flight), clipped at 0
    rem = np.maximum(values - rates * travel, 0.0)
    # battery needed for the trip; if not enough to reach and return, penalize
    d_back = np.linalg.norm(targets - charger, axis=1)
    need = (travel + d_back) * drain
    short = np.maximum(need - battery, 0.0)
    # time cost: flying there + charging what we spent (approx)
    charge_time = (travel * drain) / max(charge_rate, 1e-6)
    # urgency: item disappears soon relative to reachability
    lifespan = np.where(rates > 0, values / np.maximum(rates, 1e-9), np.inf)
    urgent = np.where(is_item, 1.0 / (1.0 + np.maximum(lifespan - travel, 0.0)), 0.0)
    score = np.where(is_item, rem - 0.5 * charge_time * 0.0 - 2.0 * short, -1.0)
    # normalise
    denom = np.max(np.abs(score)) + 1e-9
    out = score / denom
    # add small urgency tilt
    return out + 0.1 * urgent
features.measures: Net gain if we fly straight to the candidate now and collect its value, minus time cost of getting back to charger: (value - rate*travel) minus travel_time*drain*recharge_time_equivalent, normalised.

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Net gain per unit of battery spent: (value now - value lost in flight) / battery needed, with charger special-cased."""
    d = np.linalg.norm(targets - pos[None, :], axis=1)
    is_charger = values <= 0
    safe_d = np.maximum(d, 1e-6)
    # value remaining when we arrive (linear decay, floored at 0)
    decayed = np.clip(values - rates * d, 0.0, None)
    # battery needed to reach the candidate
    need = np.maximum(safe_d * drain, 1e-6)
    # effective "profit" of going there
    profit = np.where(is_charger, 0.0, decayed - rates * 0.0)
    # discount the charger: its value is battery recovery, scaled by how empty we are
    charger_pull = np.where(is_charger, (1.0 - battery) * 1.0, 0.0)
    # reachability: hurt candidates we cannot afford
    affordable = np.clip(battery / need, 0.0, 1.0)
    raw = profit / need * affordable + charger_pull
    # normalise roughly to [-1, 1]
    scale = np.max(np.abs(raw)) + 1e-6
    out = raw / scale
    return np.nan_to_num(out, nan=0.0, posinf=1.0, neginf=-1.0)
features.measures: Net gain per unit of battery spent: (value now - value lost in flight) / battery needed, with charger special-cased.

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Net value per unit of flight-and-charge time: discounted value minus battery-recharge time cost, for items only."""
    d = np.linalg.norm(targets - pos, axis=1)
    is_item = values > 0
    # drone is always full when at charger, so battery is a fixed given
    flight_t = d
    # time the item has left before it vanishes
    life = np.where(rates > 0, values / np.maximum(rates, 1e-12), 1e9)
    # value remaining when we arrive (0 if it dies en route)
    arrived = np.maximum(values - rates * flight_t, 0.0)
    # value lost to decay during the trip relative to its current value
    decay_frac = np.where(values > 0, (values - arrived) / np.maximum(values, 1e-12), 0.0)
    # time to recharge a flight home if needed: extra round trip to charger
    home_d = np.linalg.norm(charger - targets, axis=1)
    total_t = flight_t + home_d
    # energy feasibility: can we reach the item and still get back-ish
    energy = battery - d * drain
    feasible = (energy > 0).astype(float)
    # value rate: arrived value per unit total time invested (bounded)
    score = arrived / np.maximum(total_t, 1e-6)
    # penalise trips that eat most of the battery (risk of running out)
    risk = np.clip(1.0 - np.maximum(energy, 0.0) / np.maximum(battery, 1e-6), 0.0, 1.0)
    out = feasible * (score * (1.0 - decay_frac) - 0.3 * risk)
    # charger: negative small so it's chosen only when nothing attractive remains
    out = np.where(is_item, out, -0.05)
    return np.tanh(out)
features.measures: Net value per unit of flight-and-charge time: discounted value minus battery-recharge time cost, for items only.

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Value density: fraction of an item's current value kept per unit of flight time to reach it."""
    d = np.linalg.norm(targets - pos, axis=1)
    travel = d  # speed 1
    # value remaining when we arrive (can't go below 0; item gone -> nothing)
    remaining = values - rates * travel
    remaining = np.maximum(remaining, 0.0)
    # effective value density: value captured per unit time spent flying there
    with np.errstate(divide='ignore', invalid='ignore'):
        dens = np.where(d > 1e-9, remaining / np.maximum(travel, 1e-9), remaining)
    dens = np.nan_to_num(dens, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)
    # normalise to roughly [-1, 1] via tanh of a scaled density
    scale = 1.0 / (1.0 + np.abs(dens))
    out = np.tanh(dens * 0.5)
    # charger gets neutral-zero density signal
    out = np.where(values == 0, 0.0, out)
    return out

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Battery sustainability: margin allowing safe return to charger after visiting the candidate, normalised by full battery; charger scores battery deficit."""
    d = np.sqrt(np.sum((targets - pos) ** 2, axis=1))
    d_back = np.sqrt(np.sum((targets - charger) ** 2, axis=1))
    d_home = np.sqrt(np.sum((charger - pos) ** 2))
    need_round = (d + d_back) * drain
    need_one = d * drain
    home_deficit = max(d_home * drain - battery, 0.0)
    charge_time = home_deficit / max(charge_rate, 1e-6)
    wasted = min(charge_time, time_left)
    round_margin = np.clip(1.0 - need_round / (battery + 1e-6), -1.0, 1.0)
    one_margin = np.clip(1.0 - need_one / (battery + 1e-6), -1.0, 1.0)
    score = 0.5 * one_margin + 0.5 * round_margin - 0.25 * wasted
    is_charger = values == 0
    charger_score = (1.0 - battery) - 0.5 * (d_home * drain) / (battery + 1e-6)
    score = np.where(is_charger, charger_score, score)
    score = np.where(need_one > battery, -1.0, score)
    return np.clip(score, -1.0, 1.0)
features.measures: Battery sustainability: margin allowing safe return to charger after visiting the candidate, normalised by full battery; charger scores battery deficit.

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Opportunity cost of the trip: value kept on arrival minus the value the drone could have gathered per unit time elsewhere, scaled by trip time, with a horizon gate near the end."""
    d = np.linalg.norm(targets - pos, axis=1)
    is_item = values > 0

    # value still recoverable on arrival (0 if the item dies en route)
    arrived = np.maximum(values - rates * d, 0.0)

    # round-trip time budget: flight out plus the flight back to the charger
    home_d = np.linalg.norm(targets - charger, axis=1)
    trip_t = d + home_d

    # throughput the drone could get from the best other item it can see now
    # (an "opportunity cost" per unit time) computed from the current candidate set
    vmax = np.max(np.where(is_item, arrived, 0.0)) if np.any(is_item) else 0.0
    dmin = np.min(np.where(is_item, d, 1.0)) if np.any(is_item) else 1.0
    other_rate = vmax / np.maximum(dmin, 1e-6)

    # net value of this trip after paying the opportunity cost of the time it occupies
    net = arrived - other_rate * trip_t

    # normalise by the best recoverable value so the score is comparable across decisions
    scale = np.maximum(np.max(np.where(is_item, arrived, 0.0)) if np.any(is_item) else 1.0, 1e-6)
    net = net / scale

    # energy feasibility: reaching the item must be possible on the current charge
    feasible = (battery - d * drain) > 0
    net = np.where(feasible, net, -1.0)

    # end-of-horizon gate: if we can't finish the round trip before time runs out,
    # only the outbound value matters (no return to charger needed)
    late = time_left < trip_t
    net = np.where(late, arrived / scale - 1.0, net)

    # charger: slightly attractive only when the battery is low, otherwise last resort
    net = np.where(is_item, net, np.clip(0.2 - battery, -0.2, 0.2))

    return np.clip(net, -1.0, 1.0)
features.measures: Opportunity cost of the trip: value kept on arrival minus the value the drone could have gathered per unit time elsewhere, scaled by trip time, with a horizon gate near the end.

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Slack between remaining life and travel time, but only counts when the drone is energy-limited: scaled by how tight the battery is relative to round-trip need; charger neutral, decays to 0 when battery is ample."""
    d = np.linalg.norm(targets - pos, axis=1)
    flight = d  # speed 1
    ttl = np.divide(values, np.maximum(rates, 1e-9))
    is_item = values > 0

    # Slack ratio as in the parent: +1 safe, negative doomed.
    slack = ttl - flight
    ratio = np.divide(slack, np.maximum(ttl, 1e-9))
    ratio = np.clip(ratio, -1.0, 1.0)

    # Battery "tightness": how much of the battery a there-and-back trip would eat,
    # relative to what we have. ~0 when ample, >=1 when critical.
    home_d = np.linalg.norm(charger - targets, axis=1)
    roundtrip_need = (flight + home_d) * drain
    tightness = np.clip(roundtrip_need / np.maximum(battery, 1e-6), 0.0, 1.0)

    # Gate: only when battery is tight does slack matter; when battery is ample,
    # urgency is better expressed by other features, so we fade this out.
    gate = tightness * tightness  # emphasise critical cases

    out = np.where(is_item, ratio * gate, 0.0)
    return np.clip(out, -1.0, 1.0)
features.measures: Slack between remaining life and travel time, but only counts when the drone is energy-limited: scaled by how tight the battery is relative to round-trip need; charger neutral, decays to 0 when battery is ample.

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Opportunity cost of ignoring other items: candidate's own value rate minus the best value rate among other items reachable, both decayed to arrival time."""
    d = np.sqrt(np.sum((targets - pos) ** 2, axis=1))
    is_item = values > 0
    # value density per time for each candidate, decayed to arrival
    life = np.where(rates > 0, values / np.maximum(rates, 1e-12), 1e9)
    arrived = np.maximum(values - rates * d, 0.0)
    dens = arrived / np.maximum(d, 1e-6)
    # how much of each candidate's life is consumed by the trip
    life_frac = np.clip(d / np.maximum(life, 1e-6), 0.0, 1.0)
    # per-decision opportunity: compare against second-best density (exclude self)
    dens_items = np.where(is_item, dens, -1.0)
    order = np.argsort(-dens_items)
    best = dens_items[order[0]] if len(order) > 0 else 0.0
    second = dens_items[order[1]] if len(order) > 1 else 0.0
    # a candidate is valuable if it is near the top of the density ranking
    rank_gap = np.where(is_item, dens - second, 0.0)
    # combine: high if dense and its life is nearly gone (urgent) relative to competitors
    score = np.tanh(rank_gap * (1.0 + life_frac))
    # charger: mild positive early when battery is low and nearby
    charger_d = np.linalg.norm(charger - pos)
    charger_score = np.clip(1.0 - battery, 0.0, 1.0) * np.clip(1.0 - charger_d, 0.0, 1.0)
    return np.where(is_item, score, 0.3 * charger_score)
features.measures: Opportunity cost of ignoring other items: candidate's own value rate minus the best value rate among other items reachable, both decayed to arrival time.

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Round-trip battery margin: 1 - (dist to item + dist item->charger)*drain / battery if reachable, else -1; charger scores 1 - battery."""
    is_charger = values == 0
    d_out = np.linalg.norm(targets - pos[None, :], axis=1)
    d_back = np.linalg.norm(charger[None, :] - targets, axis=1)

    margin = np.where(is_charger, 1.0 - battery, margin)
    return np.clip(margin, -1.0, 1.0)

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Hard survival gate (item alive on arrival) times net value after decay, divided by flight time (value per unit time); -1 if it dies first, 0 for charger."""
    d = np.linalg.norm(targets - pos[None, :], axis=1)
    life = values / np.maximum(rates, 1e-12)
    is_item = values > 0
    survives = (d <= life) & is_item
    net = np.maximum(values - rates * d, 0.0)
    vmax = np.max(values) if values.size > 0 else 0.0
    denom = max(vmax, 1e-6)
    # value per unit of flight time: net value earned per time spent flying there
    rate_per_time = net / np.maximum(d, 1e-6)
    score = np.where(survives, rate_per_time / denom, -1.0)
    score = np.where(is_item, score, 0.0)
    return np.clip(score, -1.0, 1.0)

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Feasibility margin measured against the battery the candidate would leave: 1 - need/(battery - reserve), where reserve is the energy needed to reach the charger from the candidate; -1 if the trip or the return is impossible; charger scores 1 - battery scaled by time_left."""
    dist = np.sqrt(np.sum((targets - pos) ** 2, axis=1))
    need = dist * drain
    # energy needed to get from the candidate back to the charger
    back = np.sqrt(np.sum((targets - charger[None, :]) ** 2, axis=1)) * drain
    # energy left after arriving at the candidate
    left_after = battery - need
    # must be able to arrive and still reach the charger (unless candidate is the charger)
    is_charger = values == 0
    reserve = np.where(is_charger, 0.0, back)
    feasible = (need <= battery) & (left_after >= reserve)
    denom = np.maximum(battery - reserve, 1e-6)
    score = np.where(feasible, 1.0 - need / denom, -1.0)
    # charger: prefer it when battery is low, but less so as time runs out
    time_scale = np.clip(time_left / 20.0, 0.0, 1.0)
    score = np.where(is_charger, (1.0 - battery) * (0.5 + 0.5 * time_scale), score)
    return np.clip(score, -1.0, 1.0)

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Relative regret: a candidate's net value-per-time relative to the ensemble's best, weighted by how much of the schedule is lost if we skip it (its urgency share among all items), for items only; charger gets a battery-deficit term."""
    d = np.sqrt(np.sum((targets - pos) ** 2, axis=1))
    is_item = values > 0
    life = np.where(rates > 0, values / np.maximum(rates, 1e-12), 1e9)
    arrived = np.maximum(values - rates * d, 0.0)
    flight = np.maximum(d, 1e-6)
    dens = arrived / flight
    # total decay pressure across the candidate set (how much value is evaporating now)
    decay_pressure = np.sum(np.where(is_item, rates, 0.0)) + 1e-9
    # urgency: this item's share of the evaporating value
    urgency_share = np.where(is_item, rates / decay_pressure, 0.0)
    # relative density vs the strongest item (excluding charger rows)
    dens_items = np.where(is_item, dens, -np.inf)
    best = np.max(dens_items) if np.any(is_item) else 0.0
    best = max(best, 1e-9)
    rel = np.where(is_item, dens / best, 0.0)
    # regret combines relative density with urgency: skipping an urgent, dense item costs a lot
    # and a candidate loses more if its remaining life is short relative to the trip
    life_frac = np.clip(d / np.maximum(life, 1e-6), 0.0, 1.0)
    regret = np.tanh(rel) * (1.0 - life_frac) + urgency_share * np.tanh(rel)
    # charger: deficit weighted by the fraction of visible value it would help preserve
    charger_d = np.linalg.norm(charger - pos)
    vis_value = np.sum(np.where(is_item, values, 0.0)) + 1e-9
    near_value = np.sum(np.where(is_item, values * np.exp(-d), 0.0)) / vis_value
    charger_score = np.clip(1.0 - battery, 0.0, 1.0) * near_value * np.clip(1.0 - charger_d, 0.0, 1.0)
    return np.where(is_item, np.clip(regret, -1.0, 1.0), 0.3 * charger_score)

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Per-candidate 'go now vs charge first' comparison: for items, the net value-per-time of going now minus the same trip discounted by the recharge detour needed to afford it; for the charger, the best such item opportunity it would unlock, so the charger wins only when waiting is worth more than any current trip."""
    is_item = values > 0
    k = len(values)
    d = np.linalg.norm(targets - pos[None, :], axis=1)
    need = d * drain
    # time to recharge just enough to make this trip affordable (0 if already affordable)
    deficit = np.maximum(need - battery, 0.0)
    recharge_time = deficit / max(charge_rate, 1e-6)
    # round-trip through charger time: fly there, charge, then fly to item
    d_charger = np.linalg.norm(charger - pos)
    full_charge_time = (1.0 - battery) / max(charge_rate, 1e-6)
    detour = d_charger + full_charge_time + np.linalg.norm(targets - charger[None, :], axis=1)
    # net value per unit time going directly now
    direct = np.maximum(values - rates * d, 0.0) / np.maximum(d, 1e-6)
    # net value per unit time if we must detour through charger first (decay over the longer span)
    via_charger = np.maximum(values - rates * detour, 0.0) / np.maximum(detour, 1e-6)
    # opportunity of direct vs charged path, gated by urgency: if item dies during the detour, direct wins hard
    dies_in_detour = (values - rates * detour) <= 0.0
    opp = np.where(is_item, direct - via_charger, 0.0)
    opp = np.where(is_item & dies_in_detour, direct, opp)
    # normalise
    scale = max(1.0, float(np.max(np.abs(opp))) if k > 0 else 1.0)
    opp_n = np.tanh(opp / scale)
    # charger score: how much better the best charged-path opportunity is than the best direct one,
    # i.e. the value unlocked by topping up, plus the urgency squeeze when reserve is thin
    if np.any(is_item):
        best_direct = float(np.max(np.where(is_item, direct, -np.inf)))
        best_via = float(np.max(np.where(is_item, via_charger, -np.inf)))
        unlock = max(0.0, best_via - best_direct)
    else:
        unlock = 0.0
    # only worthwhile if battery is actually low enough that the detour is cheap relative to unlock
    reserve_pressure = np.clip(1.0 - battery, 0.0, 1.0)
    charger_score = np.tanh((unlock / scale) * reserve_pressure + reserve_pressure * (1.0 - np.clip(time_left, 0.0, 1.0)))
    return np.where(is_item, opp_n, 0.7 * charger_score)

    return np.clip(score, -1.0, 1.0)

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Feasibility margin scaled by value density: reachable items score (1 - need/battery) weighted by decayed value per unit time; charger scores (1-battery) scaled by how much reachable value is at stake."""
    dist = np.sqrt(np.sum((targets - pos) ** 2, axis=1))
    need = dist * drain
    feasible = need <= battery
    margin = np.where(feasible, 1.0 - need / (battery + 1e-6), -1.0)

    is_charger = values == 0
    is_item = ~is_charger

    # decayed value at arrival, per unit of flight time -> density
    arrived = np.maximum(values - rates * dist, 0.0)
    dens = arrived / np.maximum(dist, 1e-3)
    max_dens = np.max(np.where(is_item, dens, 0.0)) + 1e-9
    dens_n = np.clip(dens / max_dens, 0.0, 1.0)

    # items: margin (signed) times a modest density weight so reachability dominates but dense items win ties
    item_score = margin * (0.5 + 0.5 * dens_n)

    # charger: how much reachable value is at stake, times urgency of low battery
    at_stake = np.sum(np.where(is_item & feasible, dens, 0.0))
    at_stake_n = at_stake / (at_stake + max_dens + 1e-9)
    charger_score = (1.0 - battery) * (1.0 + at_stake_n)

    score = np.where(is_charger, charger_score, item_score)
    return np.clip(score, -1.5, 1.5)

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Decayed value at arrival over flight+recharge time, but the trip is only credited if it survives; else it falls back to a 'charge-then-try' value, plus a charger row that prices the option value of topping up."""
    d = np.linalg.norm(targets - pos, axis=1)
    is_item = values > 0
    flight = d
    arrive_val = np.maximum(values - rates * flight, 0.0)
    life = np.where(rates > 0, values / np.maximum(rates, 1e-12), 1e9)
    survives = flight <= life
    batt_used = d * drain
    recharge_t = batt_used / max(charge_rate, 1e-9)
    total_t = flight + recharge_t
    # rate of value gain if we go now
    now_rate = arrive_val / np.maximum(total_t, 1e-9)
    # if it dies before arrival, value is zero but we still burn the trip -> negative cost
    dead_rate = -batt_used / np.maximum(total_t, 1e-9)
    rate = np.where(survives, now_rate, dead_rate)
    # scale by the best achievable rate among items in this decision (so it's relative)
    scale = np.max(np.abs(rate[is_item])) if np.any(is_item) else 1.0
    score = rate / (scale + 1e-9)
    # charger: its worth is the option value of being able to take the best future trip
    # proxied by how much battery we've lost relative to what a full-battery best-trip would buy
    best_rate = np.max(np.where(is_item, now_rate, 0.0)) if np.any(is_item) else 0.0
    charger_d = np.linalg.norm(charger - pos)
    charger_t = charger_d + (1.0 - battery) / max(charge_rate, 1e-9)
    charger_score = np.clip((best_rate * charger_t) - best_rate * 0.0, -1.0, 1.0) * 0.0
    # option value: going to charger restores battery; worth it if best_rate*recharge_time exceeds charger_t itself
    regained = 1.0 - battery
    charge_time = regained / max(charge_rate, 1e-9)
    charger_score = np.clip((best_rate * charge_time - charge_time * 0.0) / (1.0 + abs(best_rate) + charge_time), -1.0, 1.0)
    score = np.where(is_item, score, charger_score)
    return np.clip(score, -1.0, 1.0)

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Per-candidate regret of the charger detour relative to the best direct trip, expressed as a softmax share: for items, how much of the total 'go-now' value-per-time is lost by routing through the charger; for the charger, the fraction of best-item opportunity that only becomes reachable after topping up (0 when battery is ample)."""
    is_item = values > 0
    k = len(values)
    d = np.linalg.norm(targets - pos[None, :], axis=1)
    need = d * drain
    d_charger = float(np.linalg.norm(charger - pos))
    full_charge_time = (1.0 - battery) / max(charge_rate, 1e-6)
    detour = d_charger + full_charge_time + np.linalg.norm(targets - charger[None, :], axis=1)

    # value density going direct now
    direct = np.maximum(values - rates * d, 0.0) / np.maximum(d, 1e-6)
    # value density if we detour through charger first
    via_charger = np.maximum(values - rates * detour, 0.0) / np.maximum(detour, 1e-6)

    # regret = how much density is lost by detouring (only positive losses matter)
    regret = np.where(is_item, np.maximum(direct - via_charger, 0.0), 0.0)

    # softmax-style normalisation: regret relative to the sum of all direct densities
    # so an item dominates only if its detour loss is large compared to the whole menu
    direct_sum = float(np.sum(np.where(is_item, direct, 0.0)))
    scale = max(1e-6, direct_sum + np.max(regret) if k > 0 else 1.0)
    regret_n = regret / scale

    # charger: fraction of the total direct menu that is *only* reachable after charging

    if np.any(is_item):

        unlocked = float(np.sum(np.where(is_item & dying_now & alive_via, direct, 0.0)))

        best_need = float(np.max(np.where(is_item, need, 0.0))) if k > 0 else 0.0

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Battery-independent kill-clock: for each item, the shortfall between the time to fly there and the item's remaining life, plus a term for how much value survives the recharge cycle if a top-up is needed anyway; charger row scores the largest such shortfall pressure. Orders by which items are actually lost to decay, not by value density."""
    is_item = values > 0
    d = np.linalg.norm(targets - pos[None, :], axis=1)
    life = np.where(rates > 0, values / np.maximum(rates, 1e-12), 1e9)
    # time until this item vanishes
    life = np.minimum(life, time_left)
    # time we would spend getting there, plus the recharge we'd need if we insisted on full battery first
    deficit = np.maximum(d * drain - battery, 0.0)
    overhead = deficit / max(charge_rate, 1e-6)
    trip = d + overhead
    # shortfall: positive if we arrive after death -> strong negative signal (lost cause)
    slack = life - trip
    # urgency: how tight the slack is relative to the remaining life (bounded)
    urgency = np.where(is_item, np.clip(slack / np.maximum(life, 1e-6), -1.0, 1.0), 0.0)
    # survival weight: fraction of value that would still be there on arrival
    surv = np.where(is_item, np.clip(1.0 - trip / np.maximum(life, 1e-6), 0.0, 1.0), 0.0)
    # combined: reward tight-but-survivable, punish doomed trips
    score = np.where(is_item, urgency * surv, 0.0)
    # charger: how many items are on the edge of being lost (pressure to top up before chasing them)
    if np.any(is_item):
        doomed = np.where(is_item & (slack < 0.0), 1.0, 0.0)
        near = np.where(is_item & (slack >= 0.0) & (slack < 0.15), 1.0, 0.0)
        pressure = float(np.sum(doomed) + 0.5 * np.sum(near)) / max(1.0, float(np.sum(is_item)))
    else:
        pressure = 0.0
    reserve = np.clip(1.0 - battery, 0.0, 1.0)
    charger_score = np.tanh(2.0 * pressure * (0.3 + reserve))
    return np.where(is_item, score, charger_score)

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Feasibility margin weighted by whether the item can also be banked before it dies: reachable-and-alive scores positive, else negative; charger scores by deficit and proximity."""
    dist = np.sqrt(np.sum((targets - pos) ** 2, axis=1))
    need = dist * drain
    is_item = values > 0
    feasible = need <= battery
    # battery margin as before
    margin = np.where(feasible, 1.0 - need / (battery + 1e-6), -1.0)
    # does the item survive the trip? life fraction remaining at arrival
    life = np.where(rates > 0, values / np.maximum(rates, 1e-12), 1e9)
    survive = np.clip(1.0 - dist / np.maximum(life, 1e-6), 0.0, 1.0)
    # battery after returning from item to charger (round trip plausibility)
    ret = np.sqrt(np.sum((targets - charger) ** 2, axis=1)) * drain
    can_return = np.clip(1.0 - (need + ret) / (battery + 1e-6), -1.0, 1.0)
    # combine: feasible and alive and returnable -> positive; weight the margin by survival
    item_score = margin * (0.5 + 0.5 * survive) + 0.3 * np.where(feasible, can_return, -1.0)
    # if not feasible, heavily negative but scaled by how far over
    item_score = np.where(feasible, item_score, np.minimum(item_score, -1.0))
    # charger: want it when battery low; also want it if no returnability for items
    charger_d = np.linalg.norm(charger - pos)
    charger_score = (1.0 - battery) * np.clip(1.0 - charger_d, 0.0, 1.0)
    score = np.where(is_item, item_score, charger_score)
    return np.clip(score, -1.0, 1.0)

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Value retained on arrival per unit of *end-of-horizon* opportunity cost: total time (flight+recharge) relative to remaining time, items only, charger 0; also penalises trips whose arrival exceeds time_left."""
    d = np.linalg.norm(targets - pos, axis=1)
    is_item = values > 0
    arrive_val = np.maximum(values - rates * d, 0.0)
    batt_used = d * drain
    recharge_t = np.maximum(batt_used - battery, 0.0) / max(charge_rate, 1e-9)
    total_t = d + recharge_t
    # opportunity cost: share of remaining horizon consumed by this trip
    horizon = max(time_left, 1e-6)
    share = total_t / horizon
    # only trips that finish before the end can collect anything
    finishable = (d <= time_left).astype(float)
    # value per time, weighted down by horizon share, gated by finishability
    score = finishable * arrive_val / np.maximum(total_t, 1e-9) * (1.0 - np.clip(share, 0.0, 1.0))
    # fallback: if nothing finishable, still rank by value per time so policy isn't blind
    if np.max(np.abs(score)) < 1e-9:
        score = arrive_val / np.maximum(total_t, 1e-9)
    score = np.where(is_item, score, 0.0)
    score = score / (np.max(np.abs(score)) + 1e-9)
    return np.clip(score, -1.0, 1.0)

import numpy as np
import math

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Budget pressure: how much of the remaining time/battery the candidate consumes, penalising items that strand the drone far from the charger when time and battery run low."""
    k = len(targets)
    is_item = values > 0
    d = np.sqrt(np.sum((targets - pos) ** 2, axis=1))
    # distance from candidate back to charger (cost of returning after pickup)
    d_back = np.sqrt(np.sum((targets - charger) ** 2, axis=1))
    # trip the drone commits to: out to candidate, then back to charger
    round_trip = d + d_back
    # time cost of that trip plus recharge of the battery it burns
    trip_batt = round_trip * drain
    recharge_t = trip_batt / max(charge_rate, 1e-6)
    total_t = round_trip + recharge_t
    # how much of the remaining horizon this eats (0..1+)
    time_frac = total_t / max(time_left, 1e-6)
    # how much of the current battery this eats
    batt_frac = trip_batt / max(battery, 1e-6)
    # survival: will the item last the outbound leg
    life = np.where(rates > 0, values / np.maximum(rates, 1e-12), 1e9)
    survives = (d <= life).astype(float)
    # decayed value actually kept
    kept = np.maximum(values - rates * d, 0.0)
    # score: kept value per unit of committed horizon, penalised by stranding risk
    denom = np.maximum(total_t, 1e-3)
    raw = kept / denom
    # normalise within decision by the max, keep relative ranking
    m = np.max(raw) if k > 0 else 1.0
    raw = raw / max(m, 1e-9)
    # pressure: high when the round trip is a big share of remaining time/battery
    squeeze = np.clip(np.maximum(time_frac, batt_frac), 0.0, 1.0)
    score = raw * (1.0 - 0.5 * squeeze) * survives
    # charger: strong when horizon/battery are tight and it is close
    charger_d = np.linalg.norm(charger - pos)
    tight = np.clip(1.0 - battery, 0.0, 1.0) + np.clip(1.0 - time_left / 100.0, 0.0, 1.0)
    charger_score = np.clip(tight, 0.0, 1.0) * np.clip(1.0 - charger_d, 0.0, 1.0)
    score = np.where(is_item, score, charger_score)
    return np.clip(score, -1.0, 1.0)

    margin = np.where(feasible, 1.0 - need / (battery + 1e-6), -1.0)

    life_left = np.where(rates > 0, values / np.maximum(rates, 1e-12), 1e9)
    alive = np.maximum(values - rates * dist, 0.0)
    survival = alive / (values + 1e-6)

    # combine: feasible-and-urgent items get boosted margin, infeasible items stay negative

    score = np.where(feasible, margin * weight, margin)
    is_charger = values == 0
    score = np.where(is_charger, 1.0 - battery, score)
    return np.clip(score, -1.0, 1.0)

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Per-candidate regret: how much total value is lost by picking this item instead of the best alternative, measured as sum of (density_i - density_self)_+ over all other items, plus a charge-time opportunity cost for the charger."""
    d = np.sqrt(np.sum((targets - pos) ** 2, axis=1))
    is_item = values > 0
    # value density per time for each candidate, decayed to arrival
    arrived = np.maximum(values - rates * d, 0.0)
    dens = arrived / np.maximum(d, 1e-6)
    dens_items = np.where(is_item, dens, -1.0)
    # regret: total positive excess density of others over this candidate
    dmax = np.max(dens_items)
    diff = dens_items[None, :] - dens[:, None]   # (k, k): how much other j beats candidate i
    diff = np.where(diff > 0, diff, 0.0)
    np.fill_diagonal(diff, 0.0)
    regret = diff.sum(axis=1) / (np.abs(dmax) + 1e-6)
    # normalise: high regret => low priority for that item
    score = -np.tanh(regret)
    # charger: opportunity cost = charge time * best available density, vs staying
    charger_d = np.linalg.norm(charger - pos)
    deficit = np.clip(1.0 - battery, 0.0, 1.0)
    charge_time = deficit / max(charge_rate, 1e-6)
    opp = charge_time * max(dmax, 0.0)
    charger_score = np.tanh(1.0 - opp)
    return np.where(is_item, score, 0.5 * charger_score)

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Relative slack of life over trip time, gated by whether the trip can also be banked before the end and by decay-rate urgency; charger scores 0."""
    d = np.linalg.norm(targets - pos, axis=1)
    is_item = values > 0
    life = np.where(rates > 0, values / np.maximum(rates, 1e-12), 1e9)
    # trip time: outbound flight plus any recharge the deficit would need before return
    deficit = np.maximum(d * drain - battery, 0.0)
    recharge = deficit / max(charge_rate, 1e-6)
    trip = d + recharge
    # slack ratio, clipped
    slack = np.clip((life - trip) / np.maximum(trip, 1e-6), -1.0, 1.0)
    # can we arrive before the end at all?
    reachable = np.clip((time_left - d) / np.maximum(time_left, 1e-6), -1.0, 1.0)
    # urgency: high decay rate relative to value means the item is burning fast
    urgency = np.clip(rates * trip / np.maximum(values, 1e-6), 0.0, 1.0)
    score = slack * reachable * (1.0 - urgency)
    score = np.where(is_item, np.clip(score, -1.0, 1.0), 0.0)
    return score

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Value left on the table if we go elsewhere: candidate's arrival value minus the best alternative arrival value we could get in the same trip time, for items; charger scores its recharge worth."""
    d = np.sqrt(np.sum((targets - pos) ** 2, axis=1))
    is_item = values > 0
    arrived = np.maximum(values - rates * d, 0.0)
    # best arrival value among other items (excluding self) — a "regret" baseline
    arr_items = np.where(is_item, arrived, -1.0)
    order = np.argsort(-arr_items)
    best = arr_items[order[0]] if len(order) > 0 else 0.0
    second = arr_items[order[1]] if len(order) > 1 else 0.0
    # regret = best alternative value we forgo by picking this candidate
    regret = np.where(is_item, np.maximum(best - arrived, 0.0), 0.0)
    # normalise by the candidate's own arrival value scale
    scale = np.maximum(arrived, 0.5)
    item_score = np.tanh(regret / scale)
    # charger: worth if battery low and recharge time small relative to time_left
    is_charger = values == 0
    deficit = np.clip(1.0 - battery, 0.0, 1.0)
    recharge_t = deficit / max(charge_rate, 1e-6)
    charger_score = deficit * np.clip(1.0 - recharge_t / max(time_left, 1e-6), -1.0, 1.0)
    out = np.where(is_charger, charger_score, item_score)
    return np.clip(out, -1.0, 1.0)

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Fraction of an item's remaining value lost by deciding to fly to the charger first (round trip) rather than to it now; charger scores 0."""
    d = np.linalg.norm(targets - pos, axis=1)
    is_item = values > 0
    # trip to item
    t_item = d
    # trip to item via charger: go to charger, recharge deficit, then to item
    d_ch = np.linalg.norm(charger - pos)
    d_ch_item = np.linalg.norm(targets - charger, axis=1)
    need_ch = d_ch * drain
    deficit_after_ch = np.maximum(need_ch - battery, 0.0)  # should be ~0 if reachable
    recharge = deficit_after_ch / max(charge_rate, 1e-6)
    t_via_charger = d_ch + recharge + d_ch_item
    extra = np.maximum(t_via_charger - t_item, 0.0)
    # value lost by that extra delay, as fraction of current value
    loss_frac = rates * extra / np.maximum(values, 1e-6)
    score = np.clip(loss_frac, 0.0, 1.0)
    # items that die before we could even get there directly are fully lost anyway -> 0
    travel_frac = np.clip(d / np.maximum(values / np.maximum(rates, 1e-12), 1e-6), 0.0, 1.0)
    score = score * (1.0 - travel_frac)
    return np.where(is_item, score, 0.0)

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Negative normalised count of other items that would die before the drone could reach them after visiting each candidate."""
    k = targets.shape[0]
    is_item = values > 0
    n_items = int(np.sum(is_item))
    denom = max(n_items, 1)

    # arrival time at each candidate (speed 1)
    diff = targets - pos[None, :]
    arrival = np.sqrt(np.sum(diff * diff, axis=1))  # shape (k,)

    # life of each item (guard division)
    life = values / np.maximum(rates, 1e-12)  # shape (k,)

    # pairwise distances between candidates
    dmat = np.sqrt(np.sum((targets[:, None, :] - targets[None, :, :]) ** 2, axis=2))  # (k,k)

    # would item j die before drone reaches it after visiting i?
    # threshold: arrival_i + d_ij ; condition life_j < threshold
    thresh = arrival[:, None] + dmat  # (k,k)
    dies = (life[None, :] < thresh) & is_item[None, :]  # (k,k)

    # exclude self (j == i)
    eye = np.eye(k, dtype=bool)
    dies = dies & ~eye

    lost_count = np.sum(dies, axis=1).astype(float)  # (k,)

    score = -lost_count / denom

    # charger row: -mean lost_count over items
    charger_mask = ~is_item
    if np.any(charger_mask):
        mean_lost = np.mean(lost_count[is_item]) if n_items > 0 else 0.0
        score = np.where(charger_mask, -mean_lost / denom, score)

    return score

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Feasibility margin gated by a hard urgency band: only items the trip nearly kills (trip time a large share of remaining life) get the margin, others get a decay-discounted margin; charger scores 1-battery scaled by its own feasibility."""
    dist = np.sqrt(np.sum((targets - pos) ** 2, axis=1))
    need = dist * drain
    feasible = need <= battery
    margin = np.where(feasible, 1.0 - need / (battery + 1e-6), -1.0)

    life_left = np.where(rates > 0, values / np.maximum(rates, 1e-12), 1e9)
    # fraction of the item's remaining life consumed by the trip
    life_frac = np.clip(dist / np.maximum(life_left, 1e-6), 0.0, 1.0)
    survival = np.clip(1.0 - life_frac, 0.0, 1.0)

    # hard urgency band: items whose trip eats most of their life are "now or never"
    urgent = (life_frac > 0.5).astype(float)
    # smooth weight: urgent items get full margin, others get margin shrunk by survival
    weight = urgent + (1.0 - urgent) * survival

    score = np.where(feasible, margin * weight, margin)

    # charger: feasible-and-worth-it only when actually low, scaled by its own reachability margin
    c_d = np.linalg.norm(charger - pos)
    c_need = c_d * drain
    c_margin = np.clip(1.0 - c_need / (battery + 1e-6), -1.0, 1.0)
    charger_score = (1.0 - battery) * (0.5 + 0.5 * c_margin)

    is_charger = values == 0
    score = np.where(is_charger, charger_score, score)
    return np.clip(score, -1.0, 1.0)
features.measures: Feasibility margin gated by a hard urgency band: only items the trip nearly kills (trip time a large share of remaining life) get the margin, others get a decay-discounted margin; charger scores 1-battery scaled by its own feasibility.

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Items: surviving value fraction reachable before the end; charger: urgency of a final top-up given the best still-collectable value density."""
    d = np.linalg.norm(targets - pos[None, :], axis=1)
    is_item = values > 0
    # arrival before end and enough battery (else strongly negative)
    can_reach = d <= time_left
    b_need = d * drain
    b_ok = b_need <= battery + 1e-9
    # value left after the trip, normalised by current value
    surv = (values - rates * d) / np.maximum(values, 1e-6)
    item_score = np.where(can_reach & b_ok, np.clip(surv, -1.0, 1.0), -1.0)
    # best value density (per time) among currently collectable items
    dens = np.where(is_item & (d > 1e-6), np.maximum(values - rates * d, 0.0) / np.maximum(d, 1e-6), 0.0)
    best_dens = np.max(dens) if dens.size else 0.0
    # how much value a full recharge could still unlock: best density times remaining time
    potential = best_dens * max(time_left, 0.0)
    # charger is attractive when battery is low and there is value left to chase
    low_batt = np.clip(1.0 - battery, 0.0, 1.0)
    charger_score = low_batt * np.clip(potential, 0.0, 1.0)
    out = np.where(is_item, item_score, charger_score)
    return np.clip(out, -1.0, 1.0)

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Feasibility margin measured against the battery the trip leaves after a return-to-charger detour is paid too (round-trip reserve)."""

    to_charger = np.sqrt(np.sum((charger - pos) ** 2))
    # battery cost of the outbound trip plus the trip back to the charger from the candidate
    back = np.sqrt(np.sum((targets - charger) ** 2, axis=1))
    need = dist * drain
    reserve = back * drain
    feasible = need <= battery
    # how much slack is left relative to the reserve that must remain after the pickup
    slack = battery - need - reserve
    score = np.where(feasible, np.tanh(slack / (battery + reserve + 1e-6)), -1.0)
    is_charger = values == 0
    # charger: prefer it when it is far (i.e., the reserve is cheap) and battery is low
    charger_score = (1.0 - battery) * np.tanh(to_charger)
    score = np.where(is_charger, np.clip(charger_score, -1.0, 1.0), score)
    return np.clip(score, -1.0, 1.0)

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Value that would be lost while flying to each candidate: total competing value decays during the trip, minus the candidate's own captured value, per unit time."""
    d = np.sqrt(np.sum((targets - pos) ** 2, axis=1))
    is_item = values > 0
    # decay of the candidate's own value during the trip
    own_lost = rates * d
    # competing visible items decay too; approximate as sum of other items' rates * d (decay during our trip)
    rates_others = np.where(is_item, rates, 0.0)
    total_rate = np.sum(rates_others)
    other_rate = total_rate[None] if np.isscalar(total_rate) else total_rate
    # per-candidate competing rate = total rate minus own rate (for items), charger gets full competing rate
    own_rate = np.where(is_item, rates, 0.0)
    competing = np.maximum(other_rate - own_rate, 0.0) if np.ndim(other_rate) == 0 else np.maximum(other_rate - own_rate, 0.0)
    trip_decay_loss = competing * d
    # net = captured value (decayed) minus loss of others' value during trip, normalized by trip time
    captured = np.maximum(values - rates * d, 0.0)
    net = captured - trip_decay_loss * 0.5
    per_time = net / np.maximum(d, 0.05)
    # normalise by scale of values present
    scale = np.sum(values) + 1e-6
    score = np.tanh(per_time / scale)
    is_charger = ~is_item
    score = np.where(is_charger, 0.0, score)
    return np.clip(score, -1.0, 1.0)
features.measures: Value that would be lost while flying to each candidate: total competing value decays during the trip, minus the candidate's own captured value, per unit time.

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Feasibility margin measured against the battery left after paying the trip AND the item's decay deadline: a candidate that dies before arrival is heavily penalised, and the margin is scaled by how much of the battery the trip consumes (per-decision tightness)."""
    dist = np.sqrt(np.sum((targets - pos) ** 2, axis=1))
    need = dist * drain
    battery_safe = np.maximum(battery, 1e-6)
    margin = 1.0 - need / battery_safe
    feasible = need <= battery
    # does the item survive until arrival? (charger always does)
    is_charger = values == 0
    life = np.where(rates > 0, values / np.maximum(rates, 1e-12), 1e9)
    alive_on_arrival = dist <= life
    # tightness: how much of the remaining battery this trip eats (0 = trivial, 1 = exactly drains it)
    tightness = np.clip(need / battery_safe, 0.0, 1.0)
    # score: feasibility margin, amplified when the trip is tight, killed when infeasible or dead-on-arrival
    score = np.where(feasible, margin * (0.5 + 0.5 * tightness), -1.0)
    score = np.where(alive_on_arrival | is_charger, score, -np.minimum(1.0, 1.0 + score))
    # charger: prefers to top up when battery low and the charger is close-ish, but only mildly
    charger_d = np.linalg.norm(charger - pos)
    charger_score = (1.0 - battery) * np.clip(1.0 - charger_d, 0.0, 1.0) - 0.5 * tightness[is_charger].mean() if np.any(is_charger) else 0.0
    charger_score = (1.0 - battery) * np.clip(1.0 - charger_d, 0.0, 1.0)
    score = np.where(is_charger, charger_score, score)
    return np.clip(score, -1.0, 1.0)

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Battery margin reframed as a two-sided gate: feasible items score by decayed value they still have left when the item would otherwise be lost, but the margin is measured against the battery that remains after paying for a return-to-charger leg, and only when that return is itself affordable; infeasible items are penalised by their shortfall; charger scores its recharge deficit."""
    dist = np.sqrt(np.sum((targets - pos) ** 2, axis=1))
    need = dist * drain
    # battery left after the trip and after returning to the charger from the item
    dist_home = np.sqrt(np.sum((targets - charger) ** 2, axis=1))
    need_home = dist_home * drain
    reserve = battery - need - need_home
    reachable = need <= battery
    # trip margin, upgraded to penalise not being able to come home
    margin = np.where(reachable, reserve / (battery + 1e-6), -(need - battery) / (battery + 1e-6))
    # value that survives the trip and would be lost if we go home first instead
    detour = 2.0 * dist_home + (battery < 1.0) * ((1.0 - battery) / max(charge_rate, 1e-6))
    alive_now = np.maximum(values - rates * dist, 0.0)
    alive_detour = np.maximum(values - rates * np.maximum(detour, dist), 0.0)
    detour_loss = np.clip((alive_now - alive_detour) / (values + 1e-6), 0.0, 1.0)
    # combine: prioritize items whose value dies during a recharge trip, gated by how safely we can reach them
    survival = alive_now / (values + 1e-6)
    weight = survival * (1.0 + detour_loss)
    score = margin * weight
    is_charger = values == 0
    deficit = np.clip(1.0 - battery, 0.0, 1.0) * np.clip(1.0 - dist_home / 1.5, 0.0, 1.0)
    score = np.where(is_charger, deficit, score)
    return np.clip(score, -1.0, 1.0)

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Battery headroom after committing to this candidate and then recharging at charger, relative to the best pure-item trip: for items, the surplus battery the candidate leaves for follow-up work; charger = 0."""
    d = np.sqrt(np.sum((targets - pos) ** 2, axis=1))
    is_item = values > 0
    # battery left after flying to candidate
    left_after = battery - d * drain
    # if we go item -> charger, total distance from pos via candidate to charger
    d_cand_to_charger = np.sqrt(np.sum((targets - charger) ** 2, axis=1))
    via_charger = d + d_cand_to_charger
    # fraction of battery consumed by the full item-then-charger loop
    loop_need = via_charger * drain
    # surplus battery left after completing loop and recharging back to full at charger
    # (recharging restores it, so what matters is: can we afford the loop at all, and how much
    #  of the trip is "wasted" from the perspective of pursuing this item)
    loop_feasible = loop_need <= battery
    # margin: how much of the battery would remain after the loop, as a fraction
    margin = np.where(loop_feasible, (battery - loop_need) / (battery + 1e-6), -1.0)
    # but a long direct trip is also penalised because it eats time; scale by survival of value
    arrival = d / 1.0
    survival = values / (values + rates * arrival + 1e-6)
    score = margin * survival
    out = np.where(is_item, np.clip(score, -1.0, 1.0), 0.0)
    return out

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Feasibility margin scaled by the value the trip is worth per unit of battery it burns (value/need, decayed to arrival), charger = -battery."""
    dist = np.sqrt(np.sum((targets - pos) ** 2, axis=1))
    need = dist * drain
    feasible = need <= battery
    margin = np.where(feasible, 1.0 - need / (battery + 1e-6), -1.0)
    # value still alive on arrival
    arrived = np.maximum(values - rates * dist, 0.0)
    # value gained per unit battery spent; normalise by the largest such density in this decision
    dens = arrived / (need + 1e-6)
    is_item = values > 0
    dens_items = np.where(is_item & feasible, dens, 0.0)
    top = np.max(dens_items) if dens_items.size else 0.0
    rel = dens_items / (top + 1e-9)
    # feasibility gates the reward, payoff density scales it
    score = margin * (0.5 + 0.5 * rel)
    # unreachable items are penalised harder the more battery they would have burned
    score = np.where(feasible, score, -1.0 - np.clip(need / (battery + 1e-6) - 1.0, 0.0, 1.0))
    is_charger = values == 0
    return np.where(is_charger, -battery, np.clip(score, -2.0, 1.0))

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Sign-flipped (loss) view: for each item, the value it will have wasted by arrival (decayed away) plus trip battery cost, all as a fraction of the value it could still deliver; charger scores its own waste (idle decay) as 0 and gets a small reserve penalty."""
    dist = np.sqrt(np.sum((targets - pos) ** 2, axis=1))
    is_item = values > 0
    # value that decays away during the trip (the loss if we go there)
    decay_loss = rates * dist
    # battery spent as a fraction of what's left, only counts if affordable
    batt_cost = np.where(dist * drain <= battery, dist * drain / (battery + 1e-6), 1.0)
    # value that actually survives the trip
    delivered = np.maximum(values - decay_loss, 0.0)
    # combined waste ratio: fractions lost per unit delivered (capped)
    waste = (decay_loss + batt_cost * values) / (delivered + 0.2 * values + 1e-6)
    item_score = -np.tanh(waste)
    # charger: penalised when battery is not low (going back wastes time), zero-ish when low
    charger_score = -np.clip(battery, 0.0, 1.0)
    return np.where(is_item, item_score, charger_score)

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Round-trip reserve slack per unit of *time*: how many time units of return-trip legs the leftover battery still pays for, relative to the item's remaining life; charger = low-battery/far bonus."""
    d = np.sqrt(np.sum((targets - pos) ** 2, axis=1))
    back = np.sqrt(np.sum((targets - charger) ** 2, axis=1))
    is_item = values > 0
    # battery left after outbound; split into "return leg" affordability in time units
    left_after = battery - d * drain
    # time the leftover battery can fly = left_after / drain (distance), i.e. how far it can still go
    reach_after = np.maximum(left_after, 0.0) / max(drain, 1e-6)
    # does the leftover reach the charger? ratio reach_after/back; >1 good
    ratio = np.where(back > 1e-6, reach_after / np.maximum(back, 1e-6), 2.0)
    # remaining life of the item in time units
    life = np.where(rates > 0, values / np.maximum(rates, 1e-12), 1e9)
    # margin: returning safely with time to spare vs the item dying anyway
    margin = np.tanh(ratio - 1.0)
    # only credit items whose life still exceeds the outbound trip (otherwise wasted)
    alive_after = np.clip((life - d) / np.maximum(life, 1e-6), -1.0, 1.0)
    out = margin * (0.5 + 0.5 * alive_after)
    out = np.where(left_after >= 0, out, -1.0)
    out = np.where(is_item, out, 0.0)
    # charger: attractive when battery low AND current round-trip reserve is thin
    charger_score = np.clip(1.0 - battery, 0.0, 1.0) * np.clip(1.0 - reach_after / np.maximum(np.sqrt(np.sum((charger - pos) ** 2)), 1e-6), -1.0, 1.0)
    out = np.where(is_item, out, np.clip(charger_score, -1.0, 1.0))
    return np.clip(out, -1.0, 1.0)
features.measures: Round-trip reserve slack per unit of *time*: how many time units of return-trip legs the leftover battery still pays for, relative to the item's remaining life; charger = low-battery/far bonus.

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Fraction of a candidate item's value that survives the trip, minus the fraction of the best competitor that survives, for items; charger = 0."""

    score = np.tanh(edge / (1.0 + abs(best)))
    return np.where(is_item, score, 0.0)

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Feasibility margin renormalised by the trip's share of battery, times fraction of item life recovered on arrival; charger gets the battery deficit scaled by its own round-trip cost."""
    dist = np.sqrt(np.sum((targets - pos) ** 2, axis=1))
    need = dist * drain
    # fraction of current battery the trip eats (not of max battery)
    battery_frac = need / (battery + 1e-6)
    feasible = battery_frac <= 1.0
    # margin expressed as spare capacity ratio, squashed so it saturates near empty battery
    margin = np.tanh(1.0 - battery_frac) if False else np.tanh(2.0 * (1.0 - battery_frac))
    margin = np.where(feasible, margin, -np.tanh(2.0 * (battery_frac - 1.0)))
    # recoverable value fraction: how much of the item survives the trip, relative to what would survive
    # if it were collected instantly (self-relative survival, bounded in [0,1])
    life_left = np.where(rates > 0, values / np.maximum(rates, 1e-12), 1e9)
    travel_frac_of_life = np.clip(dist / np.maximum(life_left, 1e-6), 0.0, 1.0)
    survival = 1.0 - travel_frac_of_life
    # urgency weight: items that are close to dying on the way get their margin reduced more aggressively
    weight = survival ** 2
    item_score = margin * weight
    # charger: deficit scaled by how expensive the detour is relative to remaining battery (round-trip cost proxy)

    round_trip_frac = 2.0 * charger_d * drain / (battery + 1e-6)
    charger_score = np.clip(1.0 - battery, 0.0, 1.0) * np.tanh(round_trip_frac)
    is_charger = values == 0
    out = np.where(is_charger, charger_score, item_score)

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Round-trip reserve margin but with the return leg's time cost (recharge) folded in: how many time units of slack the trip leaves before the item dies or the battery forces a recharge."""
    dist = np.sqrt(np.sum((targets - pos) ** 2, axis=1))
    to_charger = np.sqrt(np.sum((charger - pos) ** 2))
    back = np.sqrt(np.sum((targets - charger) ** 2, axis=1))
    need = dist * drain
    reserve = back * drain
    feasible = need <= battery
    slack_batt = battery - need - reserve
    # time to recharge the reserve back at the charger (if we return with reserve drained)
    recharge_time = np.maximum(-slack_batt, 0.0) / (charge_rate + 1e-6)
    # time available for the item to still be worth something at arrival
    life = np.where(rates > 0, values / np.maximum(rates, 1e-12), 1e9)
    time_slack = life - dist - recharge_time
    # normalize each into [-1, 1]: battery slack relative to full round-trip need, time slack relative to life
    bat_term = np.tanh(slack_batt / (battery + reserve + 1e-6))
    time_term = np.tanh(time_slack / np.maximum(life, 1e-6))
    # both must be non-negative for a good candidate; combine via geometric-style mean
    score = 0.5 * (bat_term + time_term) * np.where(feasible, 1.0, -1.0)
    is_charger = values == 0
    # charger: valuable when battery low OR when the round-trip reserve is likely to bite soon
    charger_score = np.clip(1.0 - battery, 0.0, 1.0) * (0.5 + 0.5 * np.tanh(to_charger))
    score = np.where(is_charger, charger_score, score)
    return np.clip(score, -1.0, 1.0)

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):

    # total value visible right now, and how much of it will decay before we could get to it
    total_val = float(np.sum(values[is_item])) if np.any(is_item) else 0.0
    # pressure = visible value that is decaying fast relative to remaining time
    if np.any(is_item):
        life_left = values[is_item] / np.maximum(rates[is_item], 1e-9)
        pressure = float(np.sum(values[is_item] * np.clip(1.0 - life_left / max(time_left, 1e-6), 0.0, 1.0)))
        pressure /= (total_val + 1e-6)
    else:
        pressure = 0.0
    # for an item: boost if trip leaves plenty of reserve AND the field is under pressure
    item_score = np.tanh(resid) * (0.5 + 0.5 * pressure)
    # charger: value of topping up scales with pressure and how empty we are
    charge_value = (1.0 - battery) * (0.5 + 0.5 * pressure)
    out = np.where(is_item, item_score, np.clip(charge_value, -1.0, 1.0))
    return np.clip(np.nan_to_num(out, nan=0.0), -1.0, 1.0)

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Round-trip reserve slack conditioned on the candidate dying before the return trip could finish: items whose remaining life is shorter than the outbound leg are scored by pure survival urgency instead of reserve."""
    dist = np.sqrt(np.sum((targets - pos) ** 2, axis=1))
    back = np.sqrt(np.sum((targets - charger) ** 2, axis=1))
    need = dist * drain
    reserve = back * drain
    feasible = need <= battery
    slack = battery - need - reserve
    reserve_score = np.where(feasible, np.tanh(slack / (battery + reserve + 1e-6)), -1.0)

    # remaining life in time units for each item (charger has rates 0)
    life = np.where(rates > 0, values / np.maximum(rates, 1e-12), 1e9)
    # does the item die before we could even reach it? does it die before we'd get back?
    dies_before_arrival = life < dist
    dies_before_return = life < (dist + back)

    # pure survival fraction at arrival (how much value is left when we get there)
    survival = np.clip((life - dist) / np.maximum(life, 1e-6), 0.0, 1.0)
    # value density of the doomed-but-reachable items, normalised across decision
    dens = np.where(values > 0, survival * values / np.maximum(dist, 1e-6), -1.0)
    dmax = np.max(dens) if np.any(values > 0) else 1.0
    dens_norm = np.where(values > 0, dens / (abs(dmax) + 1e-6), 0.0)

    # condition: if the item survives the return trip, use reserve slack;
    # if it dies before we'd get back but survives arrival, use density (grab it now);
    # if it dies before arrival, penalise.
    urgent_score = 0.7 * dens_norm + 0.3 * survival
    score = np.where(dies_before_arrival,
                     -1.0,
                     np.where(dies_before_return, urgent_score, reserve_score))

    is_charger = values == 0
    to_charger = np.sqrt(np.sum((charger - pos) ** 2))
    charger_score = (1.0 - battery) * np.tanh(to_charger)
    score = np.where(is_charger, np.clip(charger_score, -1.0, 1.0), score)
    return np.clip(score, -1.0, 1.0)

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Two-column: (a) round-trip reserve slack vs (b) decay-rate-adjusted value density, with the branch chosen by a smooth urgency weight rather than hard thresholds; charger = shortfall only when battery is low."""
    dist = np.sqrt(np.sum((targets - pos) ** 2, axis=1))
    back = np.sqrt(np.sum((targets - charger) ** 2, axis=1))
    is_item = values > 0
    is_charger = ~is_item

    need = dist * drain
    reserve = back * drain
    feasible = need <= battery
    slack = battery - need - reserve
    reserve_score = np.where(feasible, np.tanh(slack / (battery + reserve + 1e-6)), -1.0)

    # remaining life in time units
    life = np.where(rates > 0, values / np.maximum(rates, 1e-12), 1e9)
    # survival fraction at arrival (value still there when we get there)
    survival = np.clip((life - dist) / np.maximum(life, 1e-6), 0.0, 1.0)
    # decay-adjusted value density: value surviving per unit of outward flight
    dens = np.where(is_item, survival * values / np.maximum(dist, 1e-6), 0.0)
    dmax = np.max(dens) if np.any(is_item) else 1.0
    dens_norm = np.where(is_item, dens / (abs(dmax) + 1e-6), 0.0)

    # smooth urgency: how close the item is to dying before we return, in [0,1]
    # life/(dist+back): <1 means it dies before round trip; use logistic-like weight
    ratio = life / np.maximum(dist + back, 1e-6)
    # urgency high when ratio small (doomed); saturates near 0/1
    urgency = 1.0 / (1.0 + np.exp(4.0 * (ratio - 1.0)))  # ~1 if ratio<<1, ~0 if ratio>>1
    urgency = np.where(rates > 0, urgency, 0.0)

    # blended item score
    item_score = (1.0 - urgency) * reserve_score + urgency * dens_norm
    # items that die before arrival get a strong penalty scaled by how doomed
    dies_hard = (life < dist).astype(float)
    item_score = item_score - dies_hard * (1.0 + survival)

    # charger: only attractive when battery is low relative to a nominal trip
    to_charger = np.sqrt(np.sum((charger - pos) ** 2))
    charger_score = np.clip(1.0 - battery, 0.0, 1.0) * (1.0 - np.tanh(to_charger))

    score = np.where(is_charger, charger_score, item_score)
    score = np.clip(score, -2.0, 1.0)
    return score
features.measures: Two-column: (a) round-trip reserve slack vs (b) decay-rate-adjusted value density, with the branch chosen by a smooth urgency weight rather than hard thresholds; charger = shortfall only when battery is low.

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Round-trip reserve slack but only counted as a constraint: the slack is expressed as a *deficit* ratio to the reserve, and gated by whether the item will still be worth collecting when the drone gets back (survival to return)."""
    dist = np.sqrt(np.sum((targets - pos) ** 2, axis=1))
    back = np.sqrt(np.sum((targets - charger) ** 2, axis=1))
    need = dist * drain
    reserve = back * drain
    feasible = need <= battery

    # deficit: how much of the required reserve is eaten (positive = shortfall), relative to total trip cost
    total_cost = need + reserve + 1e-6
    deficit = (need + reserve - battery) / total_cost
    # slack_ratio in [-1,1]-ish: full battery covers everything -> -1; shortfall -> positive
    slack_ratio = np.where(feasible, -np.clip((battery - need - reserve) / total_cost, 0.0, 1.0),
                           np.clip(deficit, 0.0, 1.0))
    # convert to a score where more slack is better
    reserve_score = np.where(feasible, 1.0 - 2.0 * np.clip((-slack_ratio), 0.0, 1.0), -1.0)

    # gate: does the item survive long enough to still be worth something after a round trip?
    life = np.where(rates > 0, values / np.maximum(rates, 1e-12), 1e9)
    round_trip_time = dist + back
    survival_to_return = np.clip((life - round_trip_time) / np.maximum(life, 1e-6), 0.0, 1.0)

    # if the item dies before the round trip completes, reserve only matters for safety, not for the item:
    # weight reserve_score by survival_to_return, and add a small pull toward items that barely survive the round trip
    tight = np.exp(-np.abs(life - round_trip_time) / np.maximum(life, 1e-6))
    score = reserve_score * (0.5 + 0.5 * survival_to_return) + 0.2 * tight * np.where(feasible, 1.0, 0.0)

    is_charger = values == 0
    to_charger = np.sqrt(np.sum((charger - pos) ** 2))
    charger_score = (1.0 - battery) * np.tanh(to_charger)
    score = np.where(is_charger, np.clip(charger_score, -1.0, 1.0), score)
    return np.clip(score, -1.0, 1.0)
features.measures: Round-trip reserve slack but only counted as a constraint: the slack is expressed as a *deficit* ratio to the reserve, and gated by whether the item will still be worth collecting when the drone gets back (survival to return).

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Value-per-battery-unit of the trip, conditioned on the candidate's arrival survival, minus the recharge time the trip will cost; charger scores the expected value density of waiting."""
    dist = np.sqrt(np.sum((targets - pos) ** 2, axis=1))
    is_item = values > 0
    # energy needed to reach candidate, plus (for items) the reserve to get back to charger
    back = np.sqrt(np.sum((targets - charger) ** 2, axis=1))
    energy = dist * drain + np.where(is_item, back * drain, 0.0)
    # value still present at arrival
    arrival_val = np.maximum(values - rates * dist, 0.0)
    # recharge time this trip's energy will cost later (only for items; charger refills itself)
    recharge_cost = energy / np.maximum(charge_rate, 1e-6)
    # net gain per (flight + eventual recharge) time
    trip_time = dist + recharge_cost + 1e-6
    score_item = arrival_val / trip_time
    # charger: score how much worth is "on the table" per unit recharge if we go wait/recharge now
    if np.any(is_item):
        live = values[is_item]
        dens_max = np.max(live / (np.maximum(dist[is_item], 1e-6) + 1e-6))
    else:
        dens_max = 0.0
    # normalise by max, and let the charger reflect the value density of the best reachable item
    # scaled by how empty the battery is (more pressing to recharge when low)
    denom = np.max(np.abs(score_item[is_item])) + 1e-6 if np.any(is_item) else 1.0
    score_item_n = np.tanh(score_item / denom)
    charger_score = np.clip(1.0 - battery, 0.0, 1.0) * np.tanh(dens_max / (denom + 1e-6))
    return np.where(is_item, score_item_n, charger_score)

    targets = np.asarray(targets, dtype=float)

    rates = np.asarray(rates, dtype=float)

    k = targets.shape[0]
    is_item = values > 0

    dist = np.sqrt(np.sum(diff * diff, axis=1))

    # own arrival value, clipped >= 0

    own = np.where(is_item, np.maximum(own, 0.0), 0.0)

    life = np.where(is_item, values / safe_rates, 0.0)

    # field loss for candidate i: sum over j != i of rates_j * min(dist_i, life_j)
    # matrix form: loss[i] = sum_j rates_j * min(dist_i, life_j) - (own term j=i)
    # min(dist_i, life_j) depends on both i and j -> build (k, k)
    dist_col = dist[:, None]            # (k,1) dist_i

    rate_row = rates[None, :]           # (1,k) rates_j

    contrib = np.where(is_item[None, :], contrib, 0.0)    # only items contribute

    own_term = rates * np.minimum(dist, life)
    own_term = np.where(is_item, own_term, 0.0)

nodes.title: energy-scheduled trip value
nodes.description: Score each candidate by value kept on arrival divided by the full energy cycle it implies (flight + recharge detour), so trips are ranked by value per battery-time.

nodes.title: graded deadline pressure
nodes.description: Continuous urgency: how close the item's death time is to the arrival time, scaled smoothly rather than a binary gate.

nodes.title: wide find: lifetime_fraction_urgency
nodes.description: Fraction of an item's remaining lifetime consumed by the trip, signed so urgent-and-doomed ranks high; charger scores battery deficit.

nodes.title: endgame horizon truncation
nodes.description: Zero or heavily discount candidates whose arrival time exceeds time_left, and boost charger when remaining horizon is too short to complete any trip.

nodes.title: charger trip time cost
nodes.description: Price the charger by the round-trip flight time plus recharge time it consumes, relative to the best item value available now.

nodes.title: wide find: round_trip_budget_pressure
nodes.description: Budget pressure: how much of the remaining time/battery the candidate consumes, penalising items that strand the drone far from the charger when time and battery run low.

nodes.title: horizon-conditioned feasibility
nodes.description: Feasibility margin that also accounts for whether the trip plus return-to-charger fits in time_left, so late-game items are not chased at the cost of stranding.

nodes.title: opportunity-gap charger timing
nodes.description: Decide charger vs item by comparing the best item's value rate against the charger's forgone rate, scaled by battery deficit and horizon.

nodes.title: wide find: regret_vs_best_alternative
nodes.description: Value left on the table if we go elsewhere: candidate's arrival value minus the best alternative arrival value we could get in the same trip time, for items; charger scores its recharge worth.

nodes.title: two-step battery reserve
nodes.description: Feasibility margin that reserves enough charge not just to reach the charger after this item, but to make one more productive trip from the charger afterwards, penalising items that leave the drone stranded mid-horizon.

nodes.title: charger endgame opportunity
nodes.description: In the last stretch of the horizon, price the charger by the value it can still unlock (remaining items reachable after recharge) versus the value lost by detouring now.

nodes.title: arrival-intensity forecast
nodes.description: Use history appearance times to estimate the current item arrival rate and expected time to the next appearance, so the drone waits/charges when a burst is imminent rather than chasing a poor item.

nodes.title: decay-cohort burst timing
nodes.description: Detect that many visible items share similar death times (waves) and rank by whether the trip lands before the cohort dies, discounting items whose cohort is already collapsing.

nodes.title: cohort-burst-harvest
nodes.description: Count items whose death time falls within a short upcoming window and boost candidates in that cohort so the drone sweeps a dying wave before it vanishes.

nodes.title: charger-marginal-value
nodes.description: Score the charger by expected value unlocked per unit of charging time versus the value rate obtainable by continuing on current battery.

nodes.title: spatial-spread-penalty
nodes.description: Penalise candidates that sit far from other high-value visible items, favouring compact clusters so a trip collects several before returning.

nodes.title: horizon_gated_round_trip_reserve
nodes.description: f055's round-trip reserve was flat because it charged the reserve even when the return trip plus recharge cannot finish before the end (late game the reserve is worthless). Gating the reserve term on time_left >= trip + return + recharge makes it count only when the return is actually usable, sharp…

nodes.title: trip_vs_life_slack_band
nodes.description: The champion's f008 ignores whether the item will still exist on arrival. A cheap slack check: for items whose remaining life is short relative to the trip, mark how tight the trip is (trip/life); for items with ample life return 0 so the term only switches on in the tight cases.

nodes.title: route-aware chained pickup
nodes.description: Score candidates by value reachable from the candidate itself to the next-best item, so the drone prefers items that open a chain rather than dead ends.

nodes.title: wave phase anticipation
nodes.description: Use history arrival times to detect a rising wave and shift preference toward items that will still be alive when the wave peaks, not the currently oldest.

nodes.title: scatter spread coverage
nodes.description: In sparse scatter, penalise revisiting regions already harvested (via history positions) and favour candidates in unvisited area.

nodes.title: banked-value-per-charger-cycle
nodes.description: Rank candidates by the value that can be collected and banked before the next forced recharge, i.e. trip value divided by the full cycle (flight + recharge) it commits the drone to.

nodes.title: death-time cohort alignment
nodes.description: Group visible items by their death time and prefer candidates whose arrival lands just before a dense cohort dies, so a wave is swept rather than leaked.

nodes.title: unexplored-region coverage
nodes.description: Penalise candidates in regions already heavily harvested (via history positions) and favour items in fresh areas, targeting scatter's high missed_pct.

nodes.title: charger-side reserve deficit
nodes.description: Score the charger by how much battery deficit remains relative to the best reachable item's value, so charging is only chosen when it unlocks more than it costs.

nodes.title: cohort slack to death
nodes.description: For each item, slack between arrival time and its death time, aggregated with the density of co-dying items so wave cohorts rank by harvestable slack.
